metadata.title: Micron Stock Is Being Outpaced by Memory Chip Rivals SK Hynix, Samsung<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Micron Stock Is Being Outpaced by Memory Chip Rival SK Hynix
Micron stock was rallying alongside other chip names on Wednesday but lagged behind two rivals: SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics. Singapore may be the reason why.
